content:
incident-bot: 🚨 *SEV2* declared: Hosted API elevated 5xx/timeouts
Impacted: hosted inference (us-east) + OpenAI-compat endpoints
Start: now
Primary symptoms: p99 latency spike + request timeouts + intermittent 503s
Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.local/display/ENGINFRA/Hosted+Overload+Mitigation+Runbook
Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/overload-protection/hosted-overload

Tomáš Novák (IC): Taking IC. Christine can you scribe?

Christine Wong (scribe): yep.

Rafael Mendes: Looking. Initial signal: us-east routing queue depth jumped, then gateway 503/timeout. GPU pool saturation for rw-chat-large and embeddings pool in same region.

Aisha Bello: Alerts firing:
- hosted_api_p99_latency{region=us-east} > 4.5s (was ~900ms)
- runtime_queue_depth{pool=us-east-gpu-3} pinned at max
- breaker_transition_rate high on (rw-chat-large, us-east, hosted)

Sergio Costa: seeing error mix shift. 503s spiking + a bunch of 499s (clients giving up). Also 502 at edge for some long streams.

Tomáš Novák (IC): Current customer impact estimate?

Rafael Mendes: ~18-22% requests failing in us-east for the last ~6 mins. EU + us-west look ok.

incident-bot: Snapshot (auto)
- region: us-east
- top routes by error: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses
- breaker state summary (routing):
  - (rw-chat-large, us-east, hosted): OPEN
  - (rw-embed-3, us-east, hosted): HALF_OPEN
  - (rw-rerank-2, us-east, hosted): CLOSED
- shed rate (gateway): 14.8% (reason=OVERLOAD_EDGE_ADMISSION)
- shed rate (runtime): 6.3% (reason=QUEUE_FULL)
- Retry-After distribution: p50=1s p95=3s

Amara Diallo: Gateway admission control is active but looks like we’re still letting too many long-prompt streams through. Classification bug? streaming requests are marked “interactive” even when max_tokens=4096.

Ravi Menon: Routing is opening the breaker based on queue depth + gpu_util. But half-open probes are flapping (open->half-open->open) every ~20-30s.

Elena Popov: Capacity signals lagging ~45s on gpu_util. Queue depth is faster. We should bias breaker more heavily toward queue_depth until this spike passes.

Tomáš Novák (IC): Mitigation options:
1) rate shape at edge for us-east
2) shift traffic to us-west for hosted (if safe)
3) temporarily disable streaming in us-east (?)
Let’s pick something now.

Rafael Mendes: Recommend 1 + 2. We can apply rate shaping per model in gateway and increase cross-region routing weight to us-west for rw-chat-large.

Mina Haddad: +1. Routing policy supports temporary override: set us-east weight from 100 -> 30 for rw-chat-large and move remainder to us-west. Latency will increase for east-coast customers but should stop timeouts.

Tomáš Novák (IC): Do it. Rafael / Mina coordinate. Amara can you apply gateway shaping? Christine capture what we change.

Christine Wong (scribe): ✅ action: rate shaping at gateway + region shift for rw-chat-large.

Amara Diallo: Applying config in gateway (feature flag: overload_edge_shaping). Setting max_admit_rps for rw-chat-large in us-east to 75% of baseline, prioritize non-streaming.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: api-gateway config update (shaping rules)
Target: prod-us-east
Change: overload_edge_shaping=true; rw-chat-large.us-east.max_admit_rps=0.75; streaming_priority=low

Mina Haddad: Pushing routing override.

Ravi Menon: I’ll update breaker config to increase cooldown from 30s -> 90s for this pool to reduce flapping during the spike.

Tomáš Novák (IC): Ravi, do we have a safe lever that won’t require restart?

Ravi Menon: yes, breaker config is dynamic via config service. No restart.

Noah Patel: Runtime side: queue is hitting hard cap 2k reqs, then shedding at scheduler boundary. That’s expected, but we’re also seeing KV-cache pressure events. Might want to lower max_prompt_tokens for streams temporarily?

Lena Fischer: Confirmed. runtime_kv_cache_evictions spiking; once it happens p99 explodes.

Tomáš Novák (IC): Can we mitigate without changing product limits right now?

Noah Patel: If gateway deprioritizes streaming + long prompts, runtime should recover. If not, we can push a temporary “long prompt shed” threshold (prefill budget) for us-east.

Aisha Bello: Watching graphs. Queue depth plateaued but not dropping yet.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: api-gateway config update applied (prod-us-east)

Mina Haddad: Routing override live:
- rw-chat-large hosted weights: us-east=30, us-west=70
Also enabling fallback to rw-chat-medium for tier=free if breaker=open (already allowed by policy).

Nora Ahmed: Status page draft ready if we need it. Holding for now until we see if mitigations work.

incident-bot: Snapshot (auto)
- breaker state summary (routing):
  - (rw-chat-large, us-east, hosted): OPEN (cooldown now 90s)
  - (rw-chat-large, us-west, hosted): CLOSED
- gateway: admit rate down 21% (us-east), shed rate up to 19% (reason=OVERLOAD_EDGE_ADMISSION)
- p99 latency (us-east): 6.2s -> 4.1s trending down
- timeouts: still elevated

Sergio Costa: Seeing fewer 503 timeouts, more clean 429s with Retry-After. That’s actually better. But some clients are hammering (retry loop?).

Rafael Mendes: +1, seeing a couple top API keys generating 10x retries. Might be missing jitter. Support can reach out later; for now we may need stricter shaping on those tenants.

Tomáš Novák (IC): Do we have per-tenant shaping ready?

Amara Diallo: Limited. We can drop per API key at gateway if we add to the “hot key list” quickly. But prefer not unless it’s killing recovery.

Aisha Bello: p95 now back under 1.8s in us-east. p99 still ~3.9s but stable. Error rate down to ~7% and shifting from 503->429.

Ravi Menon: Breaker transitions down. Flapping mostly gone after cooldown bump.

Noah Patel: Runtime KV-cache evictions down. Queue depth decreasing.

Tomáš Novák (IC): Great. Hold steady. If error rate stays <5% for 10 mins we can start rollback of the emergency overrides.

Christine Wong (scribe): Current mitigations in place:
- gateway shaping: rw-chat-large us-east max_admit_rps=0.75 baseline; streaming deprioritized
- routing override: rw-chat-large weights us-east=30/us-west=70
- breaker cooldown: 90s for (rw-chat-large, us-east, hosted)

incident-bot: Snapshot (auto)
- p99 latency us-east: 3.7s
- overall 5xx us-east: 1.6%
- 429 us-east: 3.9% (Retry-After p50=1s p95=2s)
- breaker states:
  - rw-chat-large us-east: HALF_OPEN
  - rw-chat-large us-west: CLOSED

Tomáš Novák (IC): Looks like recovering. Let’s keep overrides another 15 min to drain and avoid oscillation.

Rafael Mendes: Agree. Also note: some OpenAI-compat clients still reporting “InternalServerError” even though we sent 429. Might be error mapping bug on that path.

Amara Diallo: That’s likely the legacy adapter returning 500 when upstream sends 429 + body. I’ll open a follow-up; for now it’s minor but confusing.

Sergio Costa: Confirm: in logs, edge returns 429 but compat middleware wraps it. Needs fix.

Connor O'Brien: Any changes needing comms to Support?

Tomáš Novák (IC): Yes, send note: elevated 429s in us-east due to overload protection; retry w/ backoff + jitter; recommend honoring Retry-After.

Christine Wong (scribe): will ping #support with guidance.

Christine Wong (scribe): (in-thread) Follow-ups (draft):
1) Investigate streaming classification bug (streaming marked interactive even for long max_tokens). Owner: Amara.
2) OpenAI-compat error mapping for 429/Retry-After. Owner: Brian Murphy (cc Amara/Sergio).
3) Capacity signal lag (gpu_util) vs queue_depth weighting. Owner: Elena/Ravi.
4) Identify top retry-loop tenants and send advisory. Owner: Dev Patel + Support.
5) Revisit breaker default cooldown for rw-chat-large in us-east (avoid flapping under step spikes). Owner: Rafael/Christine.

incident-bot: Update
Impact window: ~41 minutes
Customer impact: elevated 429/503 in us-east; cross-region latency increase for some traffic after reroute

Tomáš Novák (IC): Starting rollback plan:
- keep breaker cooldown at 90s until end of incident
- gradually move routing weight back us-east 30->60 if metrics hold
- keep gateway shaping for another 30 min then revert

Mina Haddad: Adjusting weights to us-east=60 / us-west=40 now.

incident-bot: Snapshot (auto)
- p99 latency us-east: 2.6s
- 5xx us-east: 0.8%
- 429 us-east: 2.1%
- breaker rw-chat-large us-east: CLOSED
- queue depth stable low

Tomáš Novák (IC): OK to resolve. Christine capture final state and open the follow-up tickets.

Christine Wong (scribe): Resolved at 1720870208.
Final notes:
- Breakers + load shedding prevented total cascade; error mode shifted to 429 w/ Retry-After vs long timeouts.
- Remaining issues: compat error wrapping + streaming classification.

incident-bot: ✅ Incident marked RESOLVED by Tomáš Novák
Post-incident tasks:
- Create postmortem stub
- Attach breaker snapshot + dashboards
- Link relevant PRs/config diffs
